structural_change: HBM-COLLECT10/UCF 10-21 ucie4 (FALLBACK): structural successor of the ucie3b route NEEDS_RTL (daemon hbm_pdie_ucie_colb-ucie3b-ed1ac9e76, TT -93.98 / FF +10.37 / DRC 0; reg->reg +14.77, in->reg +305.8): every TT/SS-failing endpoint is u_ptx (PMA TX abstract, ck->pma_tx 127 ps) -> pma_tx[*] output port (80 fF): the 513 port drivers were legalised median 56 / p90 132 / max 200 um from their ports (final net 108 fF, 413 ps) because the 43.2-um S channel (35 um of rows) at 4.93 pins/um also held the 513 pma_rx port buffers + ~950 hold buffers. Enlarged, not squeezed: S channel 129.6 um (PMA macros at y 129.6), outline 259.2 x 1728.0 (+86.4 um tall; digital band unchanged), pma_rx 3-129 / pma_tx 130.6-256 (4.07 pins/um, was 4.93). RTL unchanged (ucie3 @ed1ac9e76: benches + witnesses stand). HBM-UCIE9 10-21 structural successor of the ucie2 gate FAIL (ref_gate *-20261020-223234: main GRT stop on ONE ck_core root over the tx AND rx pin groups, boundary pin-flop spread 88.8 TT; fallback CTS FF spread 107.2; cross-clock -306.7 ps u_prx/q -> u_rm comb -> u_rmm/w_ce_in, an unregistered macro->macro path): (1) PMA RX output register u_prr (513 b, ck_rck) beside the rxm before the rate matcher (+1 pma_rck edge ahead of the elastic rate matcher, priced); (2) ck_core split into regional roots ck_tx (512 tx pin regs + PMA TX) and ck_rx (1,028 rx/st out regs + rate-matcher read side + SRAM read), each with its own landed reset port; the two share no net, so no landing ring is needed (0 added edges). Method of s81lk_serdes_col_lp6 (claude/s81-serdes6-1020 41cccbc13): PMA tx/rx hard abstracts ot_ucie_pma_{txm,rxm} (513 b, 108.0 x 1252.8, tools/mem_compiler/ucie_pma_gen.py; rxm clock pin on its digital face so the rck tree stays in the digital band), rate matcher ot_s81_rate_match_sr + dual-clock SRAM ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x546_m1, regional clock/reset ports ck_core/rst_core, ck_rck/rst_rck (reset landed 2 stages per region). FALLBACK (parallel): 259.2 x 1641.6 = fits the existing host_N slot (260.928 x 1653.48) without a re-grant; PMA rxm at x 10.8, txm at 140.4 (off the 43.2 lattice, WAIVED: guidance under the 09:35 rule freeze), 21.6 channel; all core pins on the N face (W/E pinless)
